_comment: Template for build_channel_map.py. Replace every value; delete pieces you do not need. Pieces run along the fibre from channel 0; each owns cols [lo, hi) (include_end adds hi). Relative file names are relative to this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
name: my cable
_spacing: TRUE spacing = nominal spacing x fibre-length multiplier from the file header
_first_channel_distance: header start distance of channel 0 (negative = inside the interrogator)
_label: optional nominal label earlier products used; written as a column, never used for lengths

tables.name: 16m
tables._note: decimated product: channel j centred on raw 2j

pieces._note: fibre inside the interrogator: header GPS of the unit
interrogator -> first anchor; often a reel stored next to the unit

slack._note: no point given: placed where the rest is uniform

pieces._note: anchors.csv: name, col, lat, lon (hammer picks + shot GPS); paths.csv from road_path.py; slack 'between' = '<first anchor>-<second anchor>'
a coil in a manhole: every channel at the shot point on the manhole
route stretched between the two waterline channels found from the waves (ends default to cols)
no anchors: along the (hand-drawn) route with the anchored fibre/path ratio; features = arc lengths on the route whose channels are reported (to compare with vehicle features)
